title: A campaign, with the audience counted by code
question: Text everyone who ordered this month 15% off matcha tomorrow morning.
expected: Finds the messaging rules: the 90-day relationship allows the audience, 15% is under the 20% cap, quiet hours end at 8am, the message must end with the opt-out wording.
Proposes the campaign with the full message.
Code recounts the audience from the consent flags itself, checks the discount and the wording, and the proposal waits for a person.

trace.question: Text everyone who ordered this month 15% off matcha tomorrow morning.
trace.answer:
I proposed the campaign, but nothing has been sent or scheduled. A person has to approve it first.

**Audience:** 76 customers ordered this month (October 2026, completed orders). I counted 18 who have a phone number and haven't unsubscribed. The code check counted 51 eligible customers instead. Its count includes people with verified consent or an order in the last 90 days, so it is wider than my October-only count. The proposal now shows 51, so check which group you want before approving.

**Message:** "Ridgeline Coffee: Thanks for stopping by this month! Enjoy 15% off any matcha drink, one use per customer, through Sunday 11/1. Text STOP to stop"

**Timing:** I proposed sending tomorrow (10/26) at 9am Mountain. Texts can't go out before 8am [Customer Messaging Policy §3, Quiet Hours].

**Checks that passed:**
- 15% is under the 20% cap.
- The message has the opt-out wording.
- Matcha is a regular category, not a Seasonal Special.
- The offer expires within 7 days [Customer Messaging Policy §5, Offers in Messages].
- The message names the restaurant and ends with "Text STOP to stop" [Customer Messaging Policy §6, Required Wording].
- Recent orderers with a phone number may be texted without a separate opt-in [Customer Messaging Policy §2, Who May Receive Texts].

**Still open:** Each customer can get at most two marketing texts a month. I can't see how many each person has already received this month, so please confirm that before approving.

detail.sql: select i.name, c.name as category, i.is_active from items i left join categories c on c.id=i.category_id where i.name ilike '%matcha%'

SELECT i.name, c.name AS category, i.is_active FROM (SELECT * FROM items WHERE merchant_id = 2) AS i LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM categories WHERE merchant_id = 2) AS c ON c.id = i.category_id WHERE i.name ILIKE '%matcha%' LIMIT 500

detail.purpose: Count October customers reachable by text
detail.sql: select count(distinct c.id) total, count(distinct c.id) filter (where c.has_phone and c.unsubscribed_at is null) reachable from orders o join customers c on c.id=o.customer_id where o.state='completed' and (o.created_at at time zone (select timezone from merchants)) >= '2026-10-01'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) FILTER(WHERE c.has_phone AND c.unsubscribed_at IS NULL) AS reachable FROM (SELECT * FROM orders WHERE merchant_id = 2) AS o JOIN (SELECT * FROM customers WHERE merchant_id = 2) AS c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.state = 'completed' AND (o.created_at AT TIME ZONE (SELECT timezone FROM (SELECT * FROM merchants WHERE id = 2) AS merchants)) >= '2026-10-01' LIMIT 500
